title: B1 Runtime Replacement Control AB
primary_question: Can runtime score-gap replacement improve the stock leg versus the V3 stock replay while preserving same NAV/account execution truth?
fixed_assumptions: stock pool fixed at HS300_ZZ500 PIT
ranking, entry, exit, execution timing, costs, and ETF sleeve unchanged
all acceptance runs executed inside Docker container backtest-v2-standalone
same-window B0 vs B1 is the decision evidence; baseline_V10_1 registry compare is secondary
key_findings: 1626 main window is mixed: B1 CAGR -0.47pct versus B0, Sharpe +0.003, MaxDD improves 3.62pct, Calmar +0.066, trades +208.
1217 guardrail fails: B1 CAGR 1.72% versus B0 14.55%, Sharpe 0.188 versus 0.826, MaxDD worsens to -41.86%.
1226 full audit fails: B1 CAGR 8.29% versus B0 16.72%, Sharpe 0.452 versus 0.788, MaxDD worsens to -45.52%.
B1 reduces 1626 cash skip count from 7875 to 7509, but increases turnover from 0.0228 to 0.0284.
Replacement execution is not atomic enough: 1626 has 89 rotation sells but only 50 same-day paired candidate buys; 1226 has 185 rotation sells and 114 same-day paired buys.
Conclusion: reject this score-gap B1 control for promotion; do not extend it as-is into combo baseline.
next_actions: Before another B1, add an atomic replacement contract: sell only if the replacement buy is executable in the same runtime pass, or cancel both.
For exact theme-protected B1, first add governed runtime inputs for stock theme tags, ETF theme proxy strength, protected holding tags, and replacement cap.
Retest on 1626 only after the atomic replacement contract is in place; do not rerun 1217/1226 until 1626 is no longer structurally flawed.

decision.reason: B1 control is a real Docker runtime AB, but it fails 1217 and 1226 and has sell-first replacement events that are not paired with same-day candidate buys.

notes.body: Docker AB completed on 1626, 1217, and 1226. B1 control is rejected for promotion because the full audit is worse and replacement execution is not atomic enough.
